observations: Photo 0 shows a hand holding a bundle of grey audio cables with black 1/4" TRS connectors; some connectors appear worn or damaged.
The cables are coiled and held together with black tape; one cable has visible white text, possibly a brand or model, but it is not legible.
Background includes musical equipment: keyboards, M-Audio speakers, headphones, and a guitar.
Photo 1 shows the same cables from a different angle, with more background equipment visible, including a fan and more keyboards.
Photo 2 provides a closer view of the connectors; some show signs of wear, corrosion, or loose shielding. One connector appears bent or misshapen.
No visible labels, tags, or packaging to identify the brand or model of the cables.
The seller claims the cables are 'UK Used Professional 1/4" TRS Balanced Audio Jack Cables – Clean & Tested!'

claims.claim: UK Used Professional 1/4" TRS Balanced Audio Jack Cables
claims.evidence: Photo 0, 1, and 2 show 1/4" TRS connectors and grey cables consistent with professional audio cables. The 'UK Used' claim cannot be verified remotely.
No visual proof of cleaning or testing. Some connectors show wear, corrosion, or damage (photo 2).

risks.risk: Connectors may be damaged or corroded, affecting signal quality or causing intermittent connections.
risks.proof: Close-up shot of each connector showing condition of pins, shielding, and housing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially non-functional or degraded performance.

risks.risk: Cables may be damaged internally (e.g., broken wires, poor shielding) not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Video of cables being bent and tested for continuity, or a multimeter test showing signal integrity.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly not working or unreliable.

risks.risk: Cables may not be truly 'balanced' if the internal wiring is incorrect or degraded.
risks.proof: Close-up of cable cutaway or internal wiring, or a test with audio equipment to confirm balanced signal.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly unbalanced or degraded performance.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of each connector showing condition of pins and housing.
Video or photo of a continuity test or signal test with audio equipment.
Photo of cable cutaway or internal wiring if possible.
response.reason: The cables are identifiable as 1/4" TRS audio cables, but critical claims like 'clean & tested' and hidden risks (damage, internal faults, balanced integrity) cannot be verified from current photos. Proof is needed to assess functionality and condition before pricing.
